Buyer VAT when reverse charge/intra-EU, exemption/intra-EU indication, fiscal representative details where applicable. Required reverse-charge words BTW verlegd/VAT reverse charge/Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfänger. Simplified invoice allowed specified sectors, up toEUR100VAT-inclusive or corrections referencing original, needing date/supplier/address/supply nature/VAT amount or calculation. N.V. VAT NL001605768B01, German-project VAT DE261052435. Dutch/German/English, no handwritten or multi-order consolidated invoices, delivery/service completed. HTML requires all documents in one PDF. Linked2025 PDF allows PDF/TIF, one invoice+support per file, multiple files per email, max9MB/about200pages, non-PO via email. Net30 after full approval unless agreed otherwise.
